categories.main_business_segments: Xiangxue Pharmaceutical primarily operates in traditional Chinese medicine manufacturing, including modern Chinese medicine and Chinese herbal pieces. The company also engages in medical devices, small quantities of Western medicine products, pharmaceutical distribution, and T-cell immunotherapy. It has a full industry chain layout from Chinese herbal planting, herbal pieces production, patent medicine manufacturing to pharmaceutical distribution and new drug development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs GMP-compliant production processes and has developed proprietary technologies such as the Chinese medicine fingerprint spectrum technology for quality control. It has established advanced TCR-T cell therapy platforms for tumor-specific antigen discovery, TCR screening and affinity optimization, protein expression, antigen preparation, T cell cloning, and clinical-grade viral vector and TCR-T cell production. Production is organized based on sales demand with strict quality management and digital traceability systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include medical institutions, large chain pharmacies, and pharmaceutical distribution enterprises. The company serves markets primarily in respiratory diseases, antiviral treatments, and oncology, with products like antiviral oral liquids, chemical orange series for respiratory ailments, and T-cell immunotherapy drugs targeting various cancers. Major customers include affiliated hospitals of traditional Chinese medicine universities and pharmaceutical distributors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant sales in Guangdong Province, Southwest China, Central China, and North, East, and Northeast China regions. It has established planting bases and production facilities in Ningxia, Sichuan, Yunnan, Guangdong, and other provinces. It also has subsidiaries and investments in Hong Kong and the UK for research and development.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xiangxue Pharmaceutical operates across the entire supply chain from upstream Chinese herbal medicine planting and raw material procurement, midstream production of herbal pieces and patent medicines, to downstream pharmaceutical distribution and retail. It also extends into innovative drug development and precision medicine, including cell therapy products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on modernizing traditional Chinese medicine, innovating new drug development models, and advancing TCR-T cell immunotherapy technologies. It emphasizes digital transformation, integration of Chinese and Western medicine resources, and development of smart medical services. R&D priorities include antiviral drugs, respiratory disease treatments, and oncology immunotherapies, with ongoing clinical trials for TCR-T products targeting soft tissue sarcoma, esophageal cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, and primary liver cancer.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of traditional Chinese medicines, chemical drugs, medical devices, and pharmaceutical distribution services. The company also earns income from licensing and collaborative R&D projects. Sales channels include direct sales to hospitals and pharmacies as well as distribution through authorized dealers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Xiangxue Pharmaceutical is positioned as a leading high-tech enterprise in the traditional Chinese medicine sector with strong R&D capabilities and a comprehensive industry chain. It competes with other major Chinese pharmaceutical companies in antiviral and respiratory medicines, as well as emerging biotech firms in cell therapy. Its unique TCR-T cell therapy platform and proprietary antiviral formulations provide competitive differentiation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 1.86 billion RMB, a 19.16% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about 858 million RMB, reflecting intensified market competition and liquidity challenges. Total assets stood at approximately 7.5 billion RMB, with a decline in net assets by 45.19%. The company is undergoing pre-restructuring due to financial pressures but maintains core business stability and ongoing R&D investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xiangxue Pharmaceutical emphasizes high-quality, efficient traditional Chinese medicines with proprietary quality control technologies such as fingerprint spectrum analysis. Its antiviral oral liquid is a flagship product recognized as a national standard and widely recommended in clinical guidelines. The company’s TCR-T cell therapy products represent innovative, highly specific, and effective treatments for solid tumors, positioning it at the forefront of precision immunotherapy in China.
